items.text: \{\text{lines in }V\}\ \leftrightarrow\ \{\text{hyperplanes in }\check V\};\qquad P(V):=\{\text{hyperplanes of }V\}=\{\text{one-dimensional quotients of }V\}
Points with values in $k'$: quotient modules of $V_{k'}=V\otimes_kk'$ which are locally free of rank one (invertible).
(a) $\widetilde L$ is locally free of rank one on $\operatorname{Spec}A$;
(b) there are $f_\alpha$ generating the unit ideal with $L_{f_\alpha}$ free of rank one over $A_{f_\alpha}$;
(d) $L$ is projective of finite type and $L_{\mathfrak p}$ is free of rank one for every prime $\mathfrak p$.
Functorial: a quotient $L$ of $V_{k'}$ gives the quotient $L\otimes_{k'}k''$ of $V_{k''}$ (right exactness), still invertible.
P(V)(S')=\{\text{invertible quotients of }f^*\mathcal M\},\quad \mathcal M=\widetilde V,\ f\colon S'\to S\qquad(\text{a Zariski sheaf})
P_i(k')=\{\,V_{k'}\twoheadrightarrow L : \text{the image of }e_i\text{ is a basis of }L\,\}\subset P(V)(k')
(a) $P_i\to P$ is an open immersion; (c$'$) $P_i$ is representable by an affine; (b) $P=\sup P_i$.
(b): the $e_i$ generate $L$, so near each point one of them is a basis (nonzero in the fibre).
A system of presheaves $F_{S'}$ with $F_{S'}|_{S''}\simeq F_{S''}$ for open immersions $S''\subset S'$ is the same as a presheaf on $\mathrm{Sch}/S$.
